We'll need to handle checked exceptions IOException, ZoneTransferException.

Write test class with @Test methods.

removeRecord null, removeRecord SOA -> IllegalArgumentException; removeRecord last NS -> IllegalArgumentException.

We'll test removal of a non-existing RRset works (no exception). Also test removing a valid RRset.

We can test with Type.A (valid) and maybe Type.ANY (should cause IllegalArgumentException from oneRRsetWithoutLock?). Actually findExactMatch calls Type.check then withReadLock. If type=Type.ANY, Type.check passes? Probably check ensures type is valid; ANY is valid but later oneRRsetWithoutLock throws IllegalArgumentException if type==ANY. So findExactMatch(origin, Type.ANY) should throw IllegalArgumentException. We'll test that.

findRecords null name; name not subdomain -> NXDOMAIN.

Wildcard handling: create wildcard record *.example.com. Use Name wild = Name.fromString("*.example.com."); add ARecord for *.example.com. Then query for foo.example.com, expect to get that ARecord via findRecords.

CNAME handling: create CNAME record for alias.example.com -> target.example.com. Query for alias with type A should return CNAME set.

Delegation: create NS record for sub.example.com (different zone). Query for sub.example.com should return delegation.

Iterator: test that iterator returns SOA first, then NS, then other records; test AXFR returns extra SOA at end.

toMasterFile: ensure string contains SOA and NS.
